description: This file defines a partial Japanese localization object for a chat application, including translations for UI elements, messages, and dynamic functions for locale-specific content.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Generates a localized input hint string based on the submit key, including instructions for submitting, line breaks, and auto-completion.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns a string indicating the current version of the application.

methods.name: IsLatest
methods.description: Indicates whether the application is using the latest version.

methods.name: CheckUpdate
methods.description: Triggers a check for application updates.

methods.name: FoundUpdate
methods.description: Returns a string indicating a new version has been found.

methods.name: Title
methods.description: Provides titles for various sections of the locale configuration, such as export format, character settings, and system prompts.
